rubrics.text: React and ReactDOM both use major version 19.
rubrics.how: Read package.json and verify that both react and react-dom use major version 19.

rubrics.text: The project includes TypeScript and Vite configuration and uses vite build for the production build.
rubrics.how: Inspect package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, and src/main.tsx to verify the required dependencies, configuration, and build script.

rubrics.text: The project includes Tailwind CSS and PostCSS configuration and declares all three Tailwind directives in the entry stylesheet.
rubrics.how: Inspect tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, and src/index.css and verify @tailwind base, components, and utilities.

rubrics.text: The production build contains dist/index.html and at least one JavaScript asset.
rubrics.how: Check dist/index.html and verify that dist/assets contains at least one JavaScript file.

rubrics.text: The game root, bubble dome, dice arena, dice, and status displays use the required exact DOM identifiers.
rubrics.how: Query the exact id and data-testid values declared in the prompt and reject substitute identifiers.

rubrics.text: Chip, bet, progressive, clear-bet, and roll controls use the required exact DOM identifiers and are real buttons.
rubrics.how: Query every interactive data-testid and verify that each matching control is an interactive button element.

rubrics.text: All five read-only getState interfaces exist: __contract, __game, __dice, __bets, and __progressives.
rubrics.how: Verify that window.__contract, __game, __dice, __bets, and __progressives each expose a getState function.

rubrics.text: All five read-only state snapshots contain the top-level fields required by the interface contract.
rubrics.how: Read each public snapshot and verify all required top-level fields.

rubrics.text: Every getState call returns a fresh snapshot that cannot mutate the live production state.
rubrics.how: Mutate a previously returned snapshot, read the state again, and verify that balance and bet arrays were not changed.

rubrics.text: The game state, betting state, and balance DOM display report the same live balance.
rubrics.how: Read __game, __bets, and the balance DOM at the same point in time and compare their numeric values.

rubrics.text: The betting state declares an exact maximum odds multiplier of 3.
rubrics.how: Read window.__bets.getState().maxOddsMultiplier and verify that it equals 3.

rubrics.text: The 390x844 portrait view presents a classic commercial Bubble Craps machine.
rubrics.how: Use a 390x844 visual capture to judge whether the full composition resembles a classic commercial Bubble Craps cabinet.

rubrics.text: The view clearly shows a transparent bubble dome, top-down three-dimensional dice, and a mechanical pulsing floor.
rubrics.how: Use a 390x844 visual capture to confirm the transparent dome, top-down 3D dice, and pulsing mechanical floor.

rubrics.text: A roll completes in the order rolling, settling, resolved.
rubrics.how: Trigger a real roll, observe live state transitions, and verify the three phases appear in order.

rubrics.text: Both dice have non-zero linear or angular velocity while rolling.
rubrics.how: Sample __dice during the rolling phase and verify that live linear or rotational motion is present.

rubrics.text: The dome floor pulse or offset changes during a roll.
rubrics.how: Sample floorPulse and floorOffset at different times while the roll is active and verify that at least one changes from zero.

rubrics.text: A second roll request is rejected while rolling is locked, and rollId increases only once.
rubrics.how: Start one roll and immediately request another; verify the duplicate request is rejected and the final rollId increases by exactly one.

rubrics.text: Across eight unforced production rolls, each die stays within 1 through 6 and the outcomes vary.
rubrics.how: Run eight production-random rolls, verify the value range, and require at least two distinct dice pairs.

rubrics.text: After settlement, both dice are marked settled and their linear and angular velocities are zero.
rubrics.how: After known roll outcomes settle, inspect isSettled, stableSamples, linearVelocity, and angularVelocity.

rubrics.text: Across multiple settled outcomes, quaternion-derived top face, dice state, DOM face, and settled result remain consistent.
rubrics.how: Cover six complementary dice pairs spanning faces 1 through 6, independently derive the top face from quaternion rotation, and compare it with state, DOM, and lastRoll.

rubrics.text: After settlement, both dice remain inside the dice arena without visually intersecting each other.
rubrics.how: Read the arena and die bounding boxes and verify both dice are inside the arena and their overlap ratio is below 0.15.

rubrics.text: The 390x844 portrait page has no horizontal overflow.
rubrics.how: Compare documentElement.scrollWidth with innerWidth at a 390x844 viewport.

rubrics.text: ROLL is a native button at least 44x44 pixels and a real click completes one roll.
rubrics.how: Measure the button element and dimensions, click it through the browser, and verify rollId increases once.

rubrics.text: All five chip values 1, 5, 10, 25, and 100 can be selected.
rubrics.how: Select each chip value and verify that each selection becomes the live selected chip.

rubrics.text: A successful bet immediately deducts the wager amount from balance.
rubrics.how: Start with balance 1000, place a 25-unit Place bet, and verify the balance becomes 975.

rubrics.text: A bet that exceeds the available balance is rejected without changing balance.
rubrics.how: Start with balance 10, attempt a 25-unit bet, and verify no bet is created and balance remains 10.

rubrics.text: Independent Place bets can be created on 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, and 10.
rubrics.how: Place one bet on each supported Place number and verify six distinct active bet IDs are created.

rubrics.text: Place bets remain working after hits and misses and are removed on 7.
rubrics.how: Create Place bets, exercise a hit, a non-hit, and a 7, and verify the expected keep-or-remove behavior and payout state.

rubrics.text: Independent Buy bets can be created on 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, and 10.
rubrics.how: Place one bet on each supported Buy number and verify six distinct active bet IDs are created.

rubrics.text: Buy bets remain working after hits and misses and are removed on 7.
rubrics.how: Create Buy bets, exercise a hit, a non-hit, and a 7, and verify the expected keep-or-remove behavior and payout state.

rubrics.text: Pass Line wins on come-out 7 or 11 and returns to come_out.
rubrics.how: Run separate come-out results of 7 and 11 and verify profit, bet removal, and phase reset.

rubrics.text: Pass Line loses on come-out 2, 3, or 12 and remains in come_out.
rubrics.how: Run separate come-out results of 2, 3, and 12 and verify loss, bet removal, and no point is established.

rubrics.text: Pass Line establishes table point 4 when a come-out roll is 4.
rubrics.how: Place a Pass Line bet, roll 4, and verify tablePhase is point, point equals 4, and the Pass bet remains active.

rubrics.text: An established Pass point wins when the point repeats and then clears the point.
rubrics.how: Establish point 4, roll 4 again, and verify profit, Pass bet removal, and phase reset.

rubrics.text: When a point is active, rolling 7 loses Pass and clears the point.
rubrics.how: Establish point 4, roll 7, and verify the loss, Pass bet removal, and point becomes null.

rubrics.text: A pending Come bet moves to its own number on a non-7/11/2/3/12 result.
rubrics.how: With a table point active, place Come, roll 5, and verify the bet becomes established on number 5.

rubrics.text: An established Come bet wins and is removed when its number repeats.
rubrics.how: Establish a Come bet on 5, roll 5 again, and verify profit and bet removal.

rubrics.text: An established Come bet loses and is removed on 7.
rubrics.how: Establish a Come bet on 4, roll 7, and verify the bet is removed without a winning credit.

rubrics.text: Pass Odds are allowed only after the Pass point is established and are capped at 3x the flat bet.
rubrics.how: Verify odds are rejected before a point, accepted up to 3x after a point, and an additional unit beyond the cap is rejected.

rubrics.text: Come Odds are allowed only after a Come bet is established on a number and are capped at 3x the flat bet.
rubrics.how: Verify odds are rejected while Come is pending, accepted up to 3x after establishment, and an additional unit beyond the cap is rejected.

rubrics.text: LOW records only unique hits from 2 through 6 and ignores duplicates.
rubrics.how: Activate LOW, run a partial sequence containing a duplicate 2, and verify targets and unique hits exactly.

rubrics.text: LOW completes once after all targets 2 through 6 are hit, clears its lights, and removes the progressive bet.
rubrics.how: Complete the LOW target sequence and verify completedCount increments, hits clears, and activeBetId becomes null.

rubrics.text: HIGH records only unique hits from 8 through 12 and ignores duplicates.
rubrics.how: Activate HIGH, run a partial sequence containing a duplicate 8, and verify targets and unique hits exactly.

rubrics.text: HIGH completes once after all targets 8 through 12 are hit, clears its lights, and removes the progressive bet.
rubrics.how: Complete the HIGH target sequence and verify completedCount increments, hits clears, and activeBetId becomes null.

rubrics.text: HIT ALL records only unique hits from 2 through 12 excluding 7.
rubrics.how: Run a partial HIT ALL sequence and verify targets exclude 7 and hits contain only the unique rolled totals.

rubrics.text: HIT ALL completes once after all ten targets are hit, clears its lights, and removes the progressive bet.
rubrics.how: Complete the final HIT ALL target and verify completedCount increments, hits clears, and activeBetId becomes null.

rubrics.text: Rolling 7 removes all active Pass, Come, Odds, Place, Buy, and progressive bets.
rubrics.how: Establish the supported bet types and odds, roll 7, and verify every recorded active bet ID is removed.

rubrics.text: Rolling 7 clears all LOW, HIGH, and HIT ALL progress lights.
rubrics.how: Create progressive hits, roll 7, and verify all three hit lists are empty and their activeBetId values are null.

rubrics.text: After every settlement, the final history record exactly matches lastRoll.
rubrics.how: Complete one known roll and compare the final history record with lastRoll, rollId, and total.

rubrics.text: Settlement ledger rollId, total, bet entries, and balanceAfter match the live game state.
rubrics.how: Complete a Pass win and compare the settlement ledger fields and resulting balance with the live state.

rubrics.text: The live balance, table phase, last result, and active-bet DOM agree with the live game state.
rubrics.how: After settlement, read the four live DOM observations and compare them with __game state.

rubrics.text: While rolling, both dice visually show credible three-dimensional tumbling, collision, and settling inside the bubble dome.
rubrics.how: Capture the real rolling phase in the portrait view and visually judge 3D perspective, differing orientations, and convincing motion rather than flat numeric replacement.

rubrics.text: Every progressive target has a progress light whose data-hit value matches the live progressive state.
rubrics.how: Query each progress-light-<track>-<number> element, create known hits, and compare data-hit with __progressives.hits.

rubrics.text: Every active bet renders a bet-chip-<betId> element with correct type, number, amount, and odds data.
rubrics.how: Create a Place bet, query its visible chip by dynamic betId, and compare data-type, data-number, data-amount, and data-odds with live state.

rubrics.text: An established Come bet renders a come-odds-<betId> control and its displayed odds stay synchronized with state.
rubrics.how: Establish a Come number, locate its dynamic odds control, add odds, and compare the control, bet-chip data-odds, and live bet odds.

rubrics.text: Both dice DOM position and settlement attributes match the live __dice state.
rubrics.how: After a known settled roll, compare die-1 and die-2 data-x/y/z, data-value, data-top-face, and data-settled with the __dice snapshot.

rubrics.text: When a real ROLL path produces 7 from multiple dice combinations, Place, Buy, and all three progressive bets lose with no stake returned.
rubrics.how: Create the five bet categories through the real UI, produce 7 as 1+6, 2+5, and 3+4 through the production roll path, and verify bets clear, progress clears, the ledger records losses, and balance does not refund the wagers.

rubrics.text: Given the same initial state and multi-roll sequence, the production ROLL path and deterministic input path produce equivalent settlement results.
rubrics.how: Run totals 2, 3, 6, 11, and 7 through both paths from the same initial state; ignoring identifiers and timestamps, compare ledgers, balance transitions, point state, active bets, and progressive progress to detect split rule logic.
